sloka: तन्न खल्वेष ते सौम्य पात्यो रावणमूर्धनि ।नह्यस्मिन्पतिते कश्चिन्मुहूर्तमपि जीवति ।। ७.२२.४४ ॥
transliteration: tanna khalveṣa te saumya pātyo rāvaṇamūrdhani ।nahyasminpatite kaścinmuhūrtamapi jīvati ।। 7.22.44 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, this unfailing staff of Time, of immeasurable power for all living beings, was created by me long ago, with Death as its foremost aspect.
